name.en-US: A Merry Jest How a Sergeant Would Learn to Play the Friar
name.pt-BR: Uma Divertida Chalaça: Como um Sargento Quis Aprender a Fazer-se Frade

description.en-US: More's comic verse tale of a sergeant who tries to play the friar and is outwitted.
description.pt-BR: Conto cômico em versos de More sobre um sargento que quer fazer-se frade e é enganado.

sources.edition: A mery gest how a sergeaunt woldelerne to be a frer, EEBO-TCP A07705.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 5 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Thomas More died in 1535; the edition is of 1557 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
